title: 2.1 Places
unit_title: Unit 2: Places, Things, Numbers and Colors
unit_outcome: Name places and things with their articles, count them, and say their color and size.
goal: Name six places with ein/eine and say what a place is with Das ist.
grammar_function: Ein/Eine + place; Das ist ein/eine + place.

cards.pedagogy_note: introduces it with a known article/is frame
storefront purposes must be visibly different
medical sign remains legible at phone size
Extra practice: It is a school.
complete audio plays full answer afterward
